description: Scaffold the npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo and the deterministic core domain + decision engine (build-priority items 1-4). This is the transparent, LLM-independent heart of the product: event/domain types, payment-failure classifier, weighted+decayed risk/trust score, behavioural pattern detectors, the RECOVER/INTERVENE/RESTRICT/SUSPEND decision engine, next-best recovery action selection, and the adaptive access state machine. All logic here is pure functions with no I/O so it is fully unit-testable and deterministic. Frontend and persistence come in later features.
steps: Create root package.json with npm workspaces ["server", "web"], scripts: build, test, dev, seed (delegating to server workspace). Add root .gitignore excluding node_modules, dist, build, .env, data/*.db, *.db, coverage. Add tsconfig base.

Create server/ workspace: package.json (type module or CJS - pick one consistently), tsconfig.json (strict true), vitest config. Install deps: express, better-sqlite3, zod, dotenv, supertest (dev), vitest (dev), typescript, @types/*.

server/src/domain/types.ts: define core enums/types - PaymentEventType, FailureClass (transient_recoverable, insufficient_funds, invalid_or_expired_method, authentication_required, suspicious_behaviour, high_confidence_avoidance), AccessState (ACTIVE, RECOVERY, GRACE, RESTRICTED, SUSPENDED, BLACKLIST_RECOMMENDED), DecisionOutcome (RECOVER, INTERVENE, RESTRICT, SUSPEND), RecoveryAction (retry, delayed_retry, payment_reminder, alternate_payment_method, upi_payment_link, update_payment_method, limited_grace_period), Customer, Subscription, PaymentEvent, BehaviouralEvent, Decision (with evidence[] and confidence), Evidence type.

server/src/engine/classifier.ts: pure function classifyFailure(event, context) mapping raw failure reason codes (model realistic Razorpay-style error codes/reasons) into FailureClass with a confidence. Include mapping table + rationale. A single transient failure must classify as recoverable, not abuse.

server/src/engine/risk.ts: pure computeRiskScore(signals) returning {score 0-100, band low/medium/high, confidence, evidence[]}. Use WEIGHTED evidence with recency/exponential decay (recent events weigh more) and confidence, NOT a raw counter. Signals: failed/successful payments, autopay cancellation frequency, cancellation timing vs renewal, repeated unpaid renewals, usage during grace/unpaid periods, cancel->resubscribe cycles, recovery success/failure history, subscription tenure. Each contributing signal produces a human-readable Evidence entry.

server/src/engine/patterns.ts: pure detectors returning matched patterns with evidence: cancellation cycling, payment-failure cycling, renewal avoidance, grace-period/value extraction, cancel->use->resubscribe loops.

server/src/engine/decision.ts: pure decide(riskResult, failureClass, patterns, accessHistory) -> Decision {outcome: RECOVER|INTERVENE|RESTRICT|SUSPEND, reasons/evidence[], recommendedAction: RecoveryAction (for recoverable), expectedRecoveryOutcome, confidence}. Rules: genuine/transient failure with low risk -> RECOVER; medium risk / concerning signals -> INTERVENE; repeated avoidance/leakage -> RESTRICT; high-confidence repeated abuse -> SUSPEND with blacklist RECOMMENDATION flag (never auto-blacklist). Next-best recovery action chosen from history (e.g. failed prior retry -> escalate to alternate method / upi link).

server/src/engine/accessState.ts: pure state machine transition(current, decision, paymentSucceeded) over ACTIVE->RECOVERY->GRACE->RESTRICTED->SUSPENDED->BLACKLIST_RECOMMENDED. Successful payment restores access where appropriate. Blacklist is only a recommendation flag, never an automatic terminal transition.

Wire a small pure orchestrator server/src/engine/index.ts evaluateCustomer(customer, events) that runs classify -> risk -> patterns -> decision -> access and returns a full explainable result including audit-ready evidence.
acceptance_criteria: npm install at root succeeds and links server workspace
npm run build (tsc in server) compiles with strict mode and zero type errors
All engine modules are pure (no DB/network imports) and export typed functions
evaluateCustomer returns a Decision containing outcome, confidence, and a non-empty evidence[] with human-readable reasons for non-trivial inputs
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm the server workspace typechecks/compiles with no errors
Add a temporary scratch invocation or rely on FEAT-004 tests; at minimum confirm tsc passes
findings: Scaffolded npm-workspaces monorepo (root package.json declares workspaces [server, web] with delegating build/test/dev/seed scripts; root .gitignore, tsconfig.base.json, .env.example, README added). Created server/ workspace as ESM ("type":"module") with strict tsconfig (extends base), vitest.config.ts (config only; tests are FEAT-004), and deps express/better-sqlite3/zod/dotenv + dev types/supertest/vitest/typescript. Implemented the pure deterministic core: domain/types.ts (all required enums/types incl. FailureClass, AccessState, DecisionOutcome, RecoveryAction, Evidence, Customer/Subscription/PaymentEvent/BehaviouralEvent/Decision + result types); engine/classifier.ts (Razorpay-style code->FailureClass mapping table with confidence + repetition escalation; single transient failure stays recoverable); engine/risk.ts (weighted, exponential recency-decayed 0-100 score with band/confidence/evidence, 30-day half-life, tenure trust credit; NOT a raw counter); engine/patterns.ts (5 detectors: cancellation_cycling, payment_failure_cycling, renewal_avoidance, grace_period_value_extraction, cancel_use_resubscribe_loop); engine/decision.ts (RECOVER/INTERVENE/RESTRICT/SUSPEND rules + next-best recovery action escalation from history; blacklist only a recommendation flag); engine/accessState.ts (ACTIVE->RECOVERY->GRACE->RESTRICTED->SUSPENDED transition, successful payment restores access, blacklist never auto-terminal); engine/decay.ts (shared decay helpers); engine/index.ts pure evaluateCustomer orchestrator (classify->risk->patterns->decision->access) returning full EvaluationResult with aggregated auditEvidence. VERIFICATION: `npm install` at root succeeded (239 pkgs, links server workspace; web workspace dir not yet present, handled gracefully). `npm run build` (tsc strict) compiles with ZERO errors. Confirmed via grep that engine/domain import no db/network/node-builtin I/O (pure). Ran a temporary scratch harness (since removed) confirming: single transient failure->RECOVER+retry (low risk, trust intact); expired card->update_payment_method; repeated avoidance/extraction->RESTRICT with non-empty evidence; successful payment->access restored to ACTIVE. Notes for later features: engine/index.ts re-exports the full engine surface; risk signal derivation from raw events lives in index.ts (buildRiskSignals) to keep risk.ts event-parsing-free; used exactOptionalPropertyTypes=false in base tsconfig; optional Decision fields are spread conditionally. Persistence/adapters/API/seed/tests/frontend intentionally NOT built (later features).
